functions.public.m1_public_identity():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m1_public_identity()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('productId',product_id,'environment',environment,'sampleKind','SYNTHETIC','bootstrapId',bootstrap_id,'contract','M1') from private.runtime_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='preview' and bootstrap_id is null and schema_version=1 and (select count(*) from private.runtime_identity)=1 and (select count(*) from judoju_control.environment_identity)=1 and exists(select 1 from judoju_control.environment_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='dev' and organization_ref='qfzgicohgpuogehdyzfx' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh') and exists(select 1 from judoju_control.schema_artifacts where version='20261114000001' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh' and runtime_environment='preview' and source_sha256='5b3c2d38206dc3c43c51db287d14584b3aa72b1f54d5b2e368e252a5fcf90caa' and state='STAGED_DISABLED')
$function$
functions.private.assert_initialized():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.assert_initialized()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if (select count(*) from private.runtime_identity)<>1 or not exists(select 1 from private.runtime_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='preview' and bootstrap_id is null and schema_version=1)
 or (select count(*) from judoju_control.environment_identity)<>1 or not exists(select 1 from judoju_control.environment_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='dev' and organization_ref='qfzgicohgpuogehdyzfx' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh')
 or not exists(select 1 from judoju_control.schema_artifacts where version='20261114000001' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh' and runtime_environment='preview' and source_sha256='5b3c2d38206dc3c43c51db287d14584b3aa72b1f54d5b2e368e252a5fcf90caa' and state='STAGED_DISABLED') then raise exception 'CLOUD_PRODUCT_NOT_INITIALIZED';end if;
end$function$
functions.public.admin_online_status():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_online_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare editors text[]:=array['public.m1_check_editor()','public.m1_editor_articles()','public.m1_get_draft(uuid)','public.m1_operation_status(uuid,text)',
  'public.m1_create_draft(uuid)','public.m1_save_draft(uuid,bigint,jsonb)','public.catalog_save_draft(uuid,bigint,jsonb,bigint)','public.m1_preview_draft(uuid,bigint,bigint,bigint)',
  'public.m1_publish_draft(uuid,bigint,bigint,bigint,bigint,text)','public.m1_set_state(uuid,bigint,text,text)','public.catalog_editor_sectors()','public.catalog_editor_index(integer,integer)',
  'public.catalog_editor_tree(bigint)','public.catalog_editor_sector(uuid,bigint,integer,integer)','public.catalog_editor_companies(integer,integer,text)','public.catalog_editor_company(uuid,bigint)',
  'public.catalog_editor_group(uuid,bigint)','public.catalog_editor_membership(uuid,bigint)','public.catalog_editor_impact(uuid,bigint)','public.catalog_apply(bigint,text,text,uuid,jsonb)',
  'public.catalog_operation_status(bigint,text,text,uuid,jsonb)'];
  sessions text[]:=array['public.m1_open_admin_session(uuid,uuid,text,text,timestamptz)','public.m1_read_admin_session(text)','public.m1_close_admin_session(text)'];
begin
  perform private.assert_server();
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'editorGrants',(select count(*) from unnest(editors) f where has_function_privilege('authenticated',f,'EXECUTE')),
    'sessionGrants',(select count(*) from unnest(sessions) f where has_function_privilege('service_role',f,'EXECUTE')),
    'activeMemberships',(select count(*) from private.admin_memberships where active),
    'openSessions',(select count(*) from private.admin_sessions where revoked_at is null and expires_at>now()),
    'adminAuthSessions',(select count(*) from auth.sessions s join private.admin_memberships m on m.user_id=s.user_id));
end$function$
functions.private.maintenance_command(p_kind text):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.maintenance_command(p_kind text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case p_kind
 when 'RESERVATIONS' then 'SET LOCAL statement_timeout=''5s''; SET LOCAL lock_timeout=''2s''; SELECT private.reservation_tick();'
 when 'CORRECTIONS' then 'SET LOCAL statement_timeout=''5s''; SET LOCAL lock_timeout=''2s''; SELECT private.correction_timeout_tick();'
 when 'RETENTION' then 'SET LOCAL statement_timeout=''5s''; SET LOCAL lock_timeout=''2s''; SELECT private.retention_tick();' end
$function$
functions.private.catalog_sector_selectable(p_sect:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.catalog_sector_selectable(p_sector uuid, p_catalog bigint, p_article_mode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_article_mode='SYNTHETIC'
 and exists(select 1 from private.runtime_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='preview' and bootstrap_id is null and schema_version=1 and (select count(*) from private.runtime_identity)=1 and (select count(*) from judoju_control.environment_identity)=1 and exists(select 1 from judoju_control.environment_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='dev' and organization_ref='qfzgicohgpuogehdyzfx' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh') and exists(select 1 from judoju_control.schema_artifacts where version='20261114000001' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh' and runtime_environment='preview' and source_sha256='5b3c2d38206dc3c43c51db287d14584b3aa72b1f54d5b2e368e252a5fcf90caa' and state='STAGED_DISABLED'))
 and exists(select 1 from private.catalog_head h join private.catalog_versions v on v.version=h.version and v.active
 join private.catalog_approvals a on a.version=h.version and a.state='APPROVED'
 join private.catalog_snapshots c on c.version=h.version
 join private.catalog_version_sectors m on m.version=h.version and m.sector_id=p_sector and m.active and m.catalog_kind='LEAF'
 join private.sectors s on s.id=m.sector_id and s.active and s.catalog_kind='LEAF' and s.catalog_version=h.version
 left join private.sectors parent on parent.id=s.parent_id
 where h.version=p_catalog and
 ((c.usage_scope='LOCAL_REFERENCE' and m.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED' and s.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED' and s.sample_kind is null
 and parent.active and parent.catalog_kind='PARENT' and parent.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED' and parent.catalog_version=h.version)
 or (c.usage_scope='LEGACY_FIXTURE' and m.metadata_kind='SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE' and s.metadata_kind='SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE' and s.sample_kind='SYNTHETIC')))
$function$
